name: tps-messager
description: Push notification delivery transport for the TPS suite via ntfy.

scripts.build: npm run settings:search:check && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: node --test scripts/test-native-settings-search.mjs && node --test scripts/test-tps-contracts.mjs && node --test scripts/test-notifier-contract.mjs && node --test scripts/test-notifier-settings.mjs && node --test scripts/test-manual-composer.mjs && node --test scripts/test-notifier-safety.mjs && node --test scripts/test-logger.mjs
